programs.notes: One of five 'PhD Programs in the IBS' (Cancer Biology, Genomics & Bioinformatics, Microbiology & Immunology, Neuroscience, Pharmacology & Physiology). Page notes students 'can expect to engage in at least 50% wet lab research activities'. Program co-director Ljubica Caldovic is at Children's National. Trainer list is formatted 'Last / First' on separate lines; manual grep found no 'Wei Li' or 'van Dam'.
